en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammapaccanīyānuloma (4), Dukatikapaṭṭhānapāḷi (3) 21.16.
Piṭṭhiduka, Kusalattika (The Subsequent Couplets, The Triplet on the Wholesome)

Conditioned by a state that is neither to be abandoned by insight nor unwholesome, a wholesome state that is not to be abandoned by insight arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. One [condition] under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is neither to be abandoned by insight nor unwholesome, an unwholesome state that is to be abandoned by insight arises by way of root-condition. Conditioned by a state that is neither to be abandoned by insight nor unwholesome, a state that is neither to be abandoned by insight...

An unwholesome state that is to be abandoned by seeing arises conditioned by a root cause. (Abbreviated. Under the root cause condition there are two; ... pe ... under the non-disappearance condition there are two.

Dependent on a neutral state that is neither to be abandoned by seeing nor neutral, a neutral state that is neither to be abandoned by seeing nor neutral arises conditioned by a root cause. Dependent on a state that is neither to be abandoned by seeing nor neutral...
Through the condition of root, an indeterminate state that is to be abandoned by vision arises. (Abbreviated. Two under root;
two under predominance … pe … two under non-disappearance.

Through a state that is neither to be abandoned by cultivation nor wholesome as condition, a wholesome state that is neither to be abandoned by cultivation arises through the condition of root. (Abbreviated.)
Under the root condition: one [formula] … pe … under the non-disappearance condition: one.

Conditioned by a wholesome state whose root is not to be abandoned by insight, a wholesome state whose root is not to be abandoned by insight arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root condition:
one … pe … under the non-disappearance condition: one.

Conditioned by a non-unwholesome state whose root is not to be abandoned by cultivation, a wholesome state whose root is not to be abandoned by cultivation arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
One [condition] under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance.
Conditioned by a state that is neither with initial application nor wholesome, a wholesome state with initial application arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)
With respect to the root condition, three; ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance, three.
Conditioned by a state that is without sustained application and is unwholesome, a state that is with sustained application and is wholesome arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated.
With respect to the root condition, three; ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance, three.
Conditioned by a state that is neither accompanied by rapture nor wholesome, a state that is accompanied by rapture and wholesome arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
Three [results] under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Conditioned by a state that is neither accompanied by zest nor wholesome, a state that is accompanied by zest and wholesome arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)
With respect to the root condition, three; ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance, three.
Conditioned by a state that is neither accompanied by pleasure nor wholesome, a state that is accompanied by pleasure and wholesome arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated.
With respect to the root condition, three; ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance, three.
Conditioned by a non-sensual, non-wholesome state accompanied by equanimity, a wholesome state accompanied by equanimity arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
Three for root; ... pe ... three for non-disappearance.
Conditioned by a non-sensual, non-wholesome state, a non-sensual wholesome state arises by way of root condition.
Conditioned by a non-virtuous state of the sense-sphere, a virtuous state of the sense-sphere arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
Two under root; ... pe ... two under non-disappearance.
Conditioned by a non-virtuous state that is not of the fine-material sphere, a virtuous state of the fine-material sphere arises by way of root condition.
Conditioned by a non-immaterial-sphere, non-wholesome state, a wholesome state that is not of the immaterial sphere arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
Two under root; ... pe ... two under non-disappearance.
Conditioned by a non-immaterial-sphere, non-wholesome state, a wholesome state that is of the immaterial sphere arises by way of root condition.
Conditioned by a non-form-sphere, non-wholesome state, a non-form-sphere wholesome state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
Two under root; ... pe ... two under non-disappearance.
Conditioned by a non-included, non-wholesome state, an included wholesome state arises by way of root condition.
Conditioned by a state that is neither included [in the mundane] nor wholesome, a state that is included and wholesome arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated.
Two under root; ... pe ... two under non-disappearance.
Conditioned by a state that is not leading out and not wholesome, a state that is leading out and wholesome arises by way of root-condition.
Conditioned by a state that is neither leading to emergence nor wholesome, a state that is not leading to emergence but is wholesome arises by way of root-condition.
(Abbreviated. Two under root; ... pe ... two under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is neither fixed nor wholesome, a state that is fixed and wholesome arises by way of root-condition. Conditioned by a state that is neither fixed nor wholesome, a state that is not fixed but is wholesome arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated.)
Under the condition of cause, there are two; ... pe ... under the condition of non-disappearance, there are two.
Conditioned by a state that is neither supreme nor wholesome, a supreme wholesome state arises by way of the condition of cause.
Conditioned by a state that is neither supreme nor wholesome, a wholesome state that is surpassable arises by way of the condition of cause. (Abbreviated.)
Under the root condition, two; ... pe ... under the non-disappearance condition, two.

Conditioned by a state that is neither with-conflict nor unwholesome, a wholesome state that is without-conflict arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root condition, one; ... pe ... under the non-disappearance condition, one.

Conditioned by a state that is neither with-conflict nor unwholesome, an unwholesome state that is with-conflict arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root condition, one; ... pe ... under the non-disappearance condition, one.
Dependent on a state that is non-conflict and indeterminate, a state that is non-conflict and indeterminate arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is non-conflict and not indeterminate, a state that is non-conflict and indeterminate arises by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. There are two for root, two for predominance … [and so on] … two for non-disappearance.
